scope: Bounded attempt to run the real XAUUSD H1 chain on data-ticks5-store: validate/quality, dataset, discovery with a non-empty gate, three-fold evidence with cost stress, persisted bundle, reproduce, and a non-production promotion-policy evaluation. No locked holdout spend and no production promotion.
evidence_level: pipeline attempt only; not validated, not profitable, not paper-traded

environment.thread_pinning: POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 for evidence, reproduce and promotion evaluation

data.source_store_mode: read-only (market data untouched; meta checksum unchanged)
data.writable_copy: backend/runs/realaccept/store (copied because the evidence writer creates <store_root>/datasets/<checksum>)

commands.command: uv run python -m scalping.cli data validate --root ../../../data-ticks5-store --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe H1

commands.result: 159 price outliers (>8 robust sigma); volume outliers none; reconciliation skipped (no second source)

commands.command: uv run python -m scalping.cli dataset build --root ../../../data-ticks5-store --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe H1 --horizon 1 --out runs/realaccept/dataset-manifest.json

POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 uv run python -m scalping.cli discovery run --root ../../../data-ticks5-store --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe H1 --max-trials 64 --population 8 --generations 6 --seed 7 --archive runs/realaccept/discovery.sqlite --out runs/realaccept/03-discovery.json --no-cache --min-trades 30 --min-expectancy-r 0.0 --min-profit-factor 1.05 --require-stress 1.5 --min-best-trades 10
commands.result: decision no_trade; 22/22 trials rejected by the gate

commands.command: POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 uv run python -m scalping.cli discovery evidence --root runs/realaccept/store --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe H1 --spec runs/realaccept/specs/15bdae8a1e154ee1d08963d9e40e6f25eca2ef551c6a4cab41dfca26a69cfa63.json --out runs/realaccept/evidence/decision-candidate.evidence.json --folds 3 --window 60 --horizon 1 --min-trades-per-fold 5 --search-budget 64 --trials 22 --seed 7 --no-cache
commands.result: refused: fold_trades_below_minimum (fold 1 closed 0 trades; the policy requires 5)

commands.command: POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 uv run python -m scalping.cli discovery evidence --root runs/realaccept/store --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe H1 --spec runs/realaccept/specs/70fe1963823c8f9d3f8a71a055b3c0cf5e77eee0334f24b802901fdaa9e44673.json --out runs/realaccept/evidence/least-bad.evidence.json --folds 3 --window 60 --horizon 1 --min-trades-per-fold 5 --search-budget 64 --trials 22 --seed 7 --no-cache
commands.result: persisted dataset artifact and bundle; evidence checksum 7819f9d9a8b4c7d4adad821efc19157fdae41b8b5cb0215ac198947a7e0e7c02

commands.command: POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 uv run python -m scalping.cli discovery reproduce --bundle runs/realaccept/evidence/least-bad.evidence.json --store-root runs/realaccept/store --out runs/realaccept/05-reproduce.json

commands.result: test policy rejected; production policy rejected; both promote_with_evidence calls refused
NoChampionError; no evidence champion exists and none can be created without production promotion

issues.note: H1 bars are one hour apart; the 10-minute gap threshold is M1-oriented. Not a data defect for H1.
retrospective robust-z warnings; extreme prints were not repaired or removed

discovery.decision_reason: the gate rejected all 22 trial(s); no candidate is eligible, so NO TRADE is the recorded result
discovery.note: Every evaluated candidate lost money at 1.5x costs or traded too little. The recorded decision candidate is a flat policy (0 validation trades).

evidence.candidate_role: least-bad gate-rejected trading candidate; used only to exercise persist/reproduce/promotion plumbing, not a winner

reproduce.note: Thread pinning (POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1) used because the 2026-11-24 smoke showed ~1e-16 regime-sum drift under the default polars pool.

production_policy_decision.note: Evaluated for the record; no holdout was attached or spent.

test_policy_attempt.message: only a registered production policy may promote; 'acceptance-test-policy' v1 digest 1927e267bd7a is not registered

production_policy_attempt.message: candidate was rejected by policy promotion-v1 v1: min_positive_fold_fraction; min_expectancy_r; min_profit_factor; min_ci_lower_r; cost_stress; stress_degradation; missing_locked_oos

paper_advance.reason: No evidence champion can be created without production promotion, and production promotion requires a locked-OOS section.

gate_result.refusal_message: no champion in scope 'XAUUSD:H1'; promote a validated candidate first

remaining_gate.name: locked_holdout_spend
remaining_gate.required_for: PROMOTION_V1 acceptance and any paper champion
remaining_gate.why_not_spent: A real locked-holdout spend is irreversible and was outside this bounded attempt. The candidate evidence is negative on every aggregate metric, so spending the one-shot holdout on it could only consume the budget, not produce a promotable champion.

limitations: One bounded search: 22 evaluations over a 4,428-bar validation slice. This is not a search for an edge and the multiple-testing denominator is 22.
The gate rejected every candidate; NO TRADE is the real outcome. No candidate cleared min_trades=30 and positive net profit at 1.5x costs.
The evidence bundle belongs to the least-bad gate-rejected trading candidate, not to a winner. It exists to exercise persist, reproduce and promotion plumbing.

Evidence aggregate expectancy is -0.077R with a 95% interval of [-0.184, +0.035]; the interval includes zero. Profit factor 0.764 and 0/3 positive folds. Nothing here is validation or profitability evidence.
The bootstrap is iid and ignores trade clustering; its interval can be tighter than the trade sequence supports.
The test split was not read or scored. No locked holdout was sealed, unlocked or spent.
Promotion was evaluated with a test-only policy and for the record with PROMOTION_V1; both rejected. No champion exists and no production promotion occurred.
A real locked-holdout spend is the remaining gate. It was deliberately not spent.

`dataset build` without `--no-cache` created a `.feature-cache/` directory under the source store. It was removed after the run; market Parquet files and the store manifest checksum were unchanged. All later stages used `--no-cache` or the writable copy.
One store, one symbol, one timeframe (XAUUSD H1 derived from ticks5). Nothing generalises beyond it.
conclusion: The chain ran through validate, quality, dataset, a gated discovery search, evidence persistence for a gate-rejected candidate, and an exact reproduce. It stopped at promotion/paper: discovery returned NO TRADE, the candidate evidence is negative on every aggregate, the test policy refused, and both promotion attempts failed closed with non_production_policy and missing_locked_oos. The one-shot locked holdout was not spent. This is pipeline and fail-closed behaviour evidence only; no validation, profitability or paper-trading claim is made.
